title: measurement data channel schema
description: One channel of acquired data. An array for rasters and grids, a 2D plot for curves and spectra. The two branches require different fields, so the union is unambiguous.

name.description: Channel name, e.g. height, deflection, amplitude, phase, current, bias, piezoresponsePhase.

direction.description: Scan direction the channel was recorded in, where forward and backward traces are kept separately.
